directory.name: Cornuto Pizzeria
directory.note: Wood-fired Neapolitan-style pizzeria on Greenwood Ave N in Phinney Ridge, open Wednesday through Sunday.

directory.name: Razzi's Pizzeria
directory.note: Long-running Greenwood pizzeria offering full gluten-free and vegan menus alongside classic Italian pizza.

directory.name: Pizzeria La Rocca
directory.note: Wood-fired Italian pizzeria founded in 2021 in the heart of Greenwood, using imported Italian flour and ingredients.

directory.name: Pi Vegan Pizzeria
directory.note: Seattle's 100% vegan pizzeria near the Roosevelt/University District line, with gluten-free and soy-free options.

directory.name: Mioposto
directory.note: Family-owned wood-fired pizzeria, bar and Italian kitchen across from Mt. Baker park, open since 2006.

directory.name: Veraci Pizza
directory.note: Wood-fired artisan pizzeria that grew out of a Ballard Farmers Market oven, now with a standalone Wedgwood location.
